application.name: Example GUI-only App
application.description: A webview desktop application whose only non-visual Surface is its own in-process IPC bridge. Under 0.2.0 this manifest reached AP-2; it is kept as the regression case for that flaw.

surfaces.description: Framework command bridge. Callable only from this application's own webview, so reachability is in-process.

actions.title: Delete provider
actions.description: Delete a configured provider and its saved settings.

effects.notes: The only confirmation gate today is a dialog in the GUI. Opening any external Surface would expose an unguarded destructive Action.

external_resources.notes: Written by this application and by at least one other product, with no policy for a concurrent write.
